name: usage-telemetry
summary: Reads the opt-in local call log every other MCP server in this collection can now append to (tool name, timestamp, ok/error -- never payloads), and aggregates it into real per-server, per-tool invocation counts.
problem: TASKS.md's build loop has a step ('check usage') that asks whether prior tools have actually been called since they shipped, but until now nothing in this repo could answer that: no telemetry, log, or callback existed from an external MCP client back into this repo, so every cycle either skipped the step or restated that the collection-index/manifest counts were unchanged (which shows a tool still *exists*, not that anything *called* it) -- see progress/quality-debt.md's standing note, and special-projects/wishlist.md's OWNER-authored [usage-telemetry] entry (2026-09-26) asking for exactly this.
